preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 1000 for x in [int(stdin.split()[0]), int(stdin.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers n and k, where 1 ≤ n, k ≤ 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(line.strip() != '' for line in stdout.splitlines()) and all(all(isinstance(int(x), int) and 1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no valid tournament exists) or a valid tournament description: first line is integer m (number of matches), followed by m lines of two distinct integers a_i and b_i (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n) representing a_i beat b_i.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (all(any(line.count(str(i)) == k for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) for i in range(1, n + 1)) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True)
postconditions.description: If a tournament exists, every team i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) appears exactly k times as a winner (i.e., appears exactly k times in the first column of the match results) and exactly k times as a loser (i.e., appears exactly k times in the second column of the match results).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (all(line.split() not in [b.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]] for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True)
postconditions.description: If a tournament exists, no pair of teams plays against each other more than once (i.e., no duplicate match results like (a_i, b_i) and (b_i, a_i) or repeated (a_i, b_i)).
